Refactored the small codebase into clearer roles. [InsertionSort.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/035_insertion_sort/InsertionSort.java) is now a pure utility with a tighter API: `sort`, `sortedCopy`, `sortRange`, and `isSorted`. The console entry point now lives in [InsertionSortDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/035_insertion_sort/InsertionSortDemo.java), and I added [InsertionSortSelfTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/035_insertion_sort/InsertionSortSelfTest.java) as a simple executable test harness covering full-array sorting, range sorting, non-mutating copies, sorted detection, and input validation.
